name: Qubes OS
description: Qubes OS is a security-focused desktop operating system based on Xen hypervisor isolation, developed by Invisible Things Lab in Warsaw. It compartmentalizes user activities into separate virtual machines to contain security breaches, offering hardware-enforced isolation as the primary security mechanism.

owner.name: Invisible Things Lab
owner.description: Polish security research and software company founded by Joanna Rutkowska in Warsaw.
